helpTexts.text: Slope is the rate of change of a linear function.
To calculate the slope, first choose two points on the graph that have clear coordinates.
Next, form a right triangle using those points and the graph.
Slope equals the vertical length of this triangle divided by the horizontal length. Calculate each of those lengths using the numbers shown on the axes. Then divide.

question: The graph shows Alex’s cell phone bill (b) in dollars as a function of his talking time (t) in minutes. Calculate the slope of the line to see how much Alex is charged per minute.
